effects.trigger: a subject is pictured with SCP-978

evidence.locator: When a subject is pictured with SCP-978, the photograph that develops shows not what the subject was doing at the time of the photo, but rather what the subject wanted to be doing.

constraints: The effect appears to be, for the most part, random.

evidence.locator: This effect appears to be, for the most part, random, sometimes showing drastic changes and deeply suppressed desires, or simple changes and alterations to the subject or their surroundings.

effects.trigger: two subjects with contrasting desires are photographed together

evidence.locator: Should two subjects with contrasting desires both be photographed together, the subjects' desires appear to 'mix' (see testing log for additional information).

effects.trigger: a photograph is produced by SCP-978

evidence.locator: All photographs produced by SCP-978 are to be cataloged along with full testing description.
